subject: reasoning
question: Laxman starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards south. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 9 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given :

 
• Laxman starts from Point A and drives 7 km towards south.
 
• He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 9 km.
 
• He then takes a right turn and drives 9 km.
 
• He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1bd844f62164df82c8cf40a240555b83c5a0bd7192ccac4a1454405fb7d5f02.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3 "**
